Nora's Place by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Nora’s Place is all about the view. Perched right on Eastern Lake, this classic lakefront beach house is a true 30A gem. A quick paddle across the calm water, or a short stroll down the street, and suddenly, there it is. The sugar-white sand and emerald-green water of Seagrove Beach! Mornings start best on the second-floor deck with a fresh cup of coffee and a deep breath of salty air.

Evenings? Fire up the grill and settle in for a sunset show that never disappoints. Inside, the lake views keep coming in the cozy living area and primary suite, king. Down the hall, a guest room, king, offers its own private bath. For those who like a little extra space, the first level has its own separate entrance, leading to a tucked-away bedroom with a queen bed and half bath, perfect for a little privacy. Eastern Lake is a stunning 30A playground, with kayaking and boating of all shapes and sizes. There’s even a nearby public boat ramp. Paddleboards are common and the fishing is great! At Oversee 30A, we’re all about making your stay smooth and stress-free. Our local team is always on hand, seven days a week, with a 24/7 emergency line, because vacations should be about relaxing, not problem-solving. Overview: - 400 steps (.2 mi) to the beach (Walton Dunes Access) - 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths (1 bedroom and a half bath downstairs with separate entry and 2 bedrooms upstairs with 2 full baths with separate entry) - 1008 sq ft - Wi-Fi - Gas grill - 2 bikes included Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest Room: King bed, private bath, TV - Guest Room: Queen bed, separate entrance, half bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
